title: Dispatch: restore missing complex M5/M8 procedure payloads on seven magic items (attempt 1)
description:
PR #455 review finding batch B2 (importer-fix-protocol applies). Reviewed clauses missing from committed mechanics — complex/procedural family files (magicItemComplexStateMachines.ts, magicItemRandomProcedures.ts, magicItemActivatedEffects.ts):
1. helm-of-brilliance: roll-1-on-fire-damage procedure — beams: each creature within 60 ft DC 17 Dex save or radiant damage equal to remaining gem count (M8); the d20-on-fire-damage trigger structure exists — verify and add the DC-17 payload.
2. iron-bands-of-binding: restrained target escape — DC 20 Str (Athletics) check as an action; on failure no retry for 24 hours (M5).
3. ring-of-shooting-stars: shooting stars — each mote: DC 15 Dex save, 5d4 fire on fail, half on success (C2 payload missing).
4. staff-of-power: (a) Power Strike — expend 1 charge on melee hit for extra 1d6 force (C2 op+effect missing); (b) retributive strike distance-banded damage with DC 17 Dex save halving per source (M8 payload missing; verify what exists).
5. staff-of-the-magi: retributive strike DC 17 payload (same shape as staff-of-power; verify shared modeling).
6. dimensional-shackles: bound creature may attempt DC 30 Str (Athletics) once every 30 days; success breaks free and destroys shackles (M5).
7. apparatus-of-the-crab: below 900 ft the vehicle takes 2d6 bludgeoning per minute (M5). Additionally decide + document: DC 20 Int (Investigation) hidden-catch check — either model it or record it as an explicit adjudicated/non-mechanical disposition with rationale (do not silently skip).
Source of truth is each record's own description; be exact on save abilities, DCs, dice, timing. Update allowlists/expectations explicitly; regenerate pack; full verify:worktree.

Regenerated canonical pack; verifier reports exact match, zero added/removed/changed records in regeneration comparison. Updated reviewed clause expectations to 1004 total (adjudicated 3, engine-pending 782, design-blocked 1, green 218) and regenerated the semi-structured boundary inventory. Focused importer/generated/inventory tests pass 278/278; typecheck and Biome pass; full verify:worktree was attempted but sandbox denies child-process git/node/npm/loopback operations (EPERM), causing unrelated environment-only failures.
